goal: Enhance CMRE AI ally with AresSC2 framework: expansion, proactive macro, multi-pronged combat, and transferable decision tree, while preserving vibe transport layer and DefendBasePolicy baseline.
acceptance: AresSC2 integrated as framework dependency (vendor or submodule)
MacroPlan replaces DefendBasePolicy economic logic (expand, workers, gas, supply, production)
CombatManeuver replaces DefendBasePolicy combat logic (threat response, retreat, kiting, focus fire, siege/unsiege)
AI reaches 3500 loop on Dead of Night with >50 army supply, >=3 bases, <20% worker loss
Decision tree is white-box: every action traceable to MacroPlan priority or CombatManeuver condition
No regression on vibe transport: P0/P1 REPL, live runner, bank observation all pass
